purpose: Typed discriminator for the B04-C absolute-window Temporal Constraint family, separating the required Schedule relationship and temporal representation from the common rule envelope.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: MaterialStateRef of the Temporal Constraint rule revision owning this typed window discriminator.
columns.value_contract: Exactly one row for every activated window rule state.

columns.name: relationship_code
columns.meaning: Required relationship between the candidate Schedule placement and this window geometry.
columns.value_contract: One of start_within, completion_within, full_placement_contained, placement_overlaps; deferred totality enforces the matching constrained Schedule facet.

columns.name: temporal_form_code
columns.meaning: Truthful temporal representation of the window geometry.
columns.value_contract: B04-C admits exactly absolute; date-span, floating-local, named-zone-local and coarse-local forms fail closed.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_window_state
primary_key.reason: At most one typed window discriminator per Temporal Constraint rule MaterialState.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_window_state_constraint_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: A window discriminator cannot exist without the owning Temporal Constraint rule envelope.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_window_state_relationship
check_constraints.reason: B04-C activates four explicit Schedule/window relationship semantics; no generic interval relation fallback exists.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_window_state_temporal_form
check_constraints.reason: B04-C remains exact absolute-window truth and fails closed for unsupported temporal forms.

indexes.name: pk_temporal_constraint_window_state
indexes.reason: Window discriminator lookup by rule MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_window_state_rule_totality
triggers.reason: Require exactly one matching absolute window geometry, no boundary payload, and an admitted relationship/facet pair for every accepted window rule state.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Immutable typed payload metadata owned one-to-one by the Temporal Constraint rule MaterialState.
state_history.current_binding: Currentness is inherited from the owning temporal_constraint_state through the shared scoped current binding; this row is not currentness authority.
state_history.chronology: No chronology is inferred from this discriminator; current-history episodes remain authoritative for accepted currentness.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime read access is SELECT-only; a changed window rule produces a new MaterialState.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the owning historical rule MaterialState.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; retirement changes currentness rather than erasing typed historical payload.

obligations: relationship is one of the four frozen B04-C relationship kinds
temporal form remains exactly absolute in B04-C
typed payload totality excludes simultaneous boundary payload
runtime has only read access required by the canonical application read model
